newsitem.title: USA: Granite files to offer 2.1 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Granite files to offer 2.1 mln shares.

text.p: Granite Financial Inc said Monday a registration statement had been filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of 2.1 million shares of its common stock.
Granite said it is offering all the shares.

Piper Jaffray Inc, Raymond James & Associates Inc and Cruttenden Roth Inc are the co-managing underwriters for the offering. It said underwriters have been granted an option to buy 315,000 additional shares to cover over-allotments.

Granite said proceeds will be used to finance general expansion of its business, including acquisitions, securitization transactions, computer system upgrades, interactive technologies and other working capital needs and general corporate purposes.
